# awscc_scn_instance (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SCN::Instance



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance_description` (String) The instance description.
- `instance_name` (String) The instance name.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags for the instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `web_app_dns_domain` (String) The WebApp DNS domain name of the instance.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the instance.
- `aws_account_id` (String) The AWS account ID that owns the instance.
- `created_time` (String) The instance creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `instance_id` (String) The instance identifier.
- `last_modified_time` (String) The instance last modified timestamp.
- `state` (String) The state of the instance.
- `version_number` (Number) The version number of the instance.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_scn_instance.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the instance

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_scn_instance.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_scn_instance.example "arn"
```
